svg.text: FOUR CULTIVATION FORMS — FROM WALLED GARDENS TO OPEN-FIELD VITICULTURE

g.text: microclimate — retains heat, blocks salt wind
in alluvial soil amended with lagoon silt
thicker cuticles and deeper root systems
partial windbreak and shade for vines
above saline water table and tidal reach

svg.text: Data: Consorzio Vini Venezia · Laguna nel Bicchiere project · ISMAR-CNR lagoon soil surveys · adapted from Scarpa & Tomasi (2018)
